Engraved t.p., with printed table of contents on verso.

Engraved t.p., with printed table of contents on verso. Contents vary slightly from Wit 3 and Wit 4 in I. C. Koeman. Atlantes neerlandici, v. 3, p. 194-195. Some maps signed by engraver: A. Deur (1 map), J. de Broen (1 map), J. Lhuilier (4 maps, 1 dated 1662) The maps and t.p. illustration are hand-colored. Inscription: 1722. Di Giaco. Soranzo.
